coverage.listing: All size triples in {0,1,2,3}^3, eight seeded arbitrary Boolean relations each; varying caps, cutoffs and shuffled depth-first child orders.
coverage.local_lifts: Every proper prime divisor p of each composite M<=36, all p^3 potential triples and (M/p)^3 kernel-offset triples in one coordinate.
coverage.masks: All q in [2,36], all 8 edge-presence patterns, all q^3 one-coordinate plus-label triples.
coverage.graphs: 360 seeded complete inputs of sides 1..6, dimensions 1..3, twelve listed composite moduli, independent randomized capped witness subsets; ordinary and dense-gauge quotient modes.
coverage.exponents: Exact rational ledger for every M in [2,2048].

limits: Finite semantic checks with brute-force detectors; no asymptotic benchmark or formal proof. No proposer test code imported or frozen file changed.
